external_reference_status: Original descriptive prompts for single-object product images. The owner's photographic scene references (runs/refset_1024_refs) were not uploaded to either generator.
dimension_basis: Real-world sizes authored in the Ginkgo pass (runs/refset_1024/worlds/jp.py PROPS); height normalised exactly, width and depth measured after uniform scaling. Not a physical survey.
rights: Reference images generated on the owner's Higgsfield account (gpt_image_2_5) and meshes on the owner's paid Meshy account; the Ginkgo pass records both as owner-owned output with commercial rights. Owner approved release in the Almond library under CC BY 4.0 on 2026-11-05. These props also appear inside the owner's GRANDWHIS world packs. Generator account entitlements not independently audited.
estimated_credits: 0 for this import (generation already paid in Ginkgo: 30 Meshy credits and about 0.25 Higgsfield credit per prop)
